implementation.primitive: Vp8MacroblockDecision.Luma4 evaluates full pure rate/header cost after quantization and before reconstruction/distortion/texture. Reject only when this lower bound already ties/exceeds the incumbent full score. Surviving candidates compute the exact original full metric once.
implementation.proof: FullScore=(R+H)*lambda+256*(D+S). Valid byte tiles and normalized nonnegative texture weights make D,S>=0; factory texture cost is nonnegative. Therefore the rate/header term is a lower bound. >= preserves the original strict tie order. Residual is a pure lookup/sum over unchanged quantized levels and immutable ushort rate tables. It has no admission/cache/counter side effects. Quantization, clipping, error diffusion, chosen metric fields and publication order are unchanged.

arithmetic.note: At most16pairs of ushort coefficient costs plus2ushort EOB costs and140penalty; header is ushort. Compute rateCost as Int64 before multiplication. Bounded byte distortion/spectral terms preserve original Int64 score bounds; no floating point or tolerance.

implementation.ownership: Same admitted16KiB macroblock workspace, borrowed buffers/plans and direct cancellation at each mode. No new storage, owner, reservation, cache, scope or refusal fallback. Actual async users and caller-root lifetime unchanged.

diagnostic.scope: One existing control only; counts guide the mathematical dataflow change, not CPU attribution or a universal skip-rate claim.
